data.label:
AP Invoice
Working Capital · owned

data.label:
AR Invoice
Working Capital · owned
data.name: ARInvoice
data.sub:
A receivable item in Working Capital 360: money a Customer owes a Legal Entity. A kind of Transaction. Source: Enterprise Ontology app, SAP_ENTERPRISE_ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
Component Lot
Supply Chain · reused
data.name: ComponentLot
data.sub:
A received supplier lot of a BOM component, with inspection result. A kind of Item. In the supply chain model: A Component Lot is supplied by a Supplier (N:1). A System Serial contains a Component Lot (N:N). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
3 representation(s)

data.label:
Cost Center
Finance · owned
data.name: CostCenter
data.sub:
A Finance 360 cost center that collects expense. A kind of Org Unit. In the enterprise model: a Department is funded by Cost Centers. Source: Enterprise Ontology app, SAP_ENTERPRISE_ONTOLOGY.
2 representation(s)

data.label:
Customer
Supply Chain · reused
data.name: Customer
data.sub:
An organisation that receives finished output. A kind of Party. In the supply chain model: A Plant ships to a Customer (N:N). A Sales Order is placed by a Customer (N:1). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
3 representation(s)

data.label:
Department
Enterprise · owned
data.name: Department
data.sub:
A conformed department, joining People 360 departments to Finance 360 cost centers. A kind of Org Unit. In the enterprise model: an Employee is in a Department, and a Department is funded by Cost Centers. Source: Enterprise Ontology app, SAP_ENTERPRISE_ONTOLOGY.
2 representation(s)

data.label:
Employee
People · owned
data.name: Employee
data.sub:
A worker in the People 360 workforce. A kind of Party. In the enterprise model: a Legal Entity employs an Employee, and an Employee is in a Department. Source: Enterprise Ontology app, SAP_ENTERPRISE_ONTOLOGY.
2 representation(s)

data.label:
GL Account
Finance · owned
data.name: GLAccount
data.sub:
A general ledger account in the Finance 360 chart of accounts. Source: Enterprise Ontology app, SAP_ENTERPRISE_ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
Journal Entry
Finance · owned
data.name: JournalEntry
data.sub:
A posted accounting document in Finance 360. A kind of Transaction. Source: Enterprise Ontology app, SAP_ENTERPRISE_ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
Legal Entity
Enterprise · owned
data.name: LegalEntity
data.sub:
A company code: the golden legal entity that books revenue, owes suppliers and employs people (US, EU and Japan Operations). A kind of Org Unit. In the enterprise model: a Legal Entity employs Employees, buys from and owes Suppliers, sells to Customers, and owns Plants. Source: Enterprise Ontology app, SAP_ENTERPRISE_ONTOLOGY.
5 representation(s)

data.label:
Local Customer
Enterprise · owned
data.name: LocalCustomer
data.sub:
A customer record as one 360 app knows it, before conforming. Each Local Customer is the same as exactly one golden Customer and is a member of a Legal Entity. A kind of Party. Source: Enterprise Ontology app, SAP_ENTERPRISE_ONTOLOGY.
3 representation(s)

data.label:
Local Supplier
Enterprise · owned
data.name: LocalSupplier
data.sub:
A supplier record as one 360 app knows it, before conforming. Each Local Supplier is the same as exactly one golden Supplier. A kind of Party. Source: Enterprise Ontology app, SAP_ENTERPRISE_ONTOLOGY.
3 representation(s)

data.label:
Material
Enterprise · owned
data.name: Material
data.sub:
A manufactured system or bill-of-materials component. A kind of Product. In the enterprise model: a Supplier supplies a component Material. Source: Enterprise Ontology app, SAP_ENTERPRISE_ONTOLOGY.
0 representation(s)

data.label:
Material Flow
Supply Chain · reused
data.name: MaterialFlow
data.sub:
A recurring movement of one material category between two entities, carrying monthly volume and value. Reified as a class because the flow itself has attributes the endpoints do not. Abstract class covering Inbound Flow, Outbound Flow, Inter Plant Flow. In the supply chain model: A Material Flow carries a Material Category (N:1). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
2 representation(s)

data.label:
Opportunity
Sales · owned
data.name: Opportunity
data.sub:
A CRM opportunity in the Sales 360 pipeline. A kind of Transaction. Source: Enterprise Ontology app, SAP_ENTERPRISE_ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
Org Unit
Enterprise · owned
data.name: OrgUnit
data.sub:
An internal organisational unit that owns cost, revenue or people: a legal entity, department, cost center, profit center or sales organisation. Abstract: it has no instances of its own. Source: Enterprise Ontology app, SAP_ENTERPRISE_ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
Party
Supply Chain · reused
data.name: Party
data.sub:
An external organisation the network trades with. Abstract, so a question about 'who is affected' can span suppliers and customers in one answer. Abstract class covering Supplier, Customer. Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
Plant
Supply Chain · reused
data.name: Plant
data.sub:
A manufacturing site. Carries capacity (work centres, hours, spare units) and inventory (days of cover, stock value) as properties, because both are 1:1 with the plant rather than entities in their own right. A kind of Facility. In the supply chain model: A Plant can substitute for another Plant (N:N). A Plant produces a Material Category (N:N). A Plant ships to a Customer (N:N). A Plant transfers material to another Plant (N:N). A Sales Order is fulfilled by a Plant (N:1). A Supplier supplies a Plant (N:N). A System Serial is built at a Plant (N:1). An Equipment is installed at a Plant (N:1). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
8 representation(s)

data.label:
Product
Enterprise · owned
data.name: Product
data.sub:
Something the business makes, sells or buys. Abstract: Material and Sellable Product are kinds of Product. Source: Enterprise Ontology app, SAP_ENTERPRISE_ONTOLOGY.
0 representation(s)

data.label:
Profit Center
Finance · owned
data.name: ProfitCenter
data.sub:
A Finance 360 profit center that reports revenue and margin. A kind of Org Unit. Source: Enterprise Ontology app, SAP_ENTERPRISE_ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
Purchase Order

A purchase order line in Spend 360. A kind of Transaction. Source: Enterprise Ontology app, SAP_ENTERPRISE_ONTOLOGY.

Sales Order
Supply Chain · reused

data.sub:
A customer order line for an inspection system, with OTIF outcome and late cost. A kind of Transaction. In the supply chain model: A Sales Order is fulfilled by a Plant (N:1). A Sales Order is placed by a Customer (N:1). A System Serial is shipped on a Sales Order (N:1). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
2 representation(s)

data.label:
Sales Org
Sales · owned
data.name: SalesOrg
data.sub:
A Sales 360 sales organisation. A kind of Org Unit. Source: Enterprise Ontology app, SAP_ENTERPRISE_ONTOLOGY.
0 representation(s)

data.label:
Sellable Product
Sales · owned
data.name: SellableProduct
data.sub:
An SAP product master record that can be sold. A kind of Product. Source: Enterprise Ontology app, SAP_ENTERPRISE_ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
Spend Category
Spend · owned
data.name: SpendCategory
data.sub:
A procurement category in Spend 360. In the enterprise model: a Supplier is in a Spend Category. Source: Enterprise Ontology app, SAP_ENTERPRISE_ONTOLOGY.
2 representation(s)

data.label:
Supplier
Supply Chain · reused
data.name: Supplier
data.sub:
An organisation that ships material into a plant. A kind of Party. In the supply chain model: A Component Lot is supplied by a Supplier (N:1). A Supplier supplies a Plant (N:N). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
5 representation(s)

Transaction
